name: Kometa-Asset-Manager
description: KAM (Kometa Asset Manager) manages the artwork in your Kometa asset folders. It connects to Plex, shows every movie, show and collection next to the artwork Kometa will use, and lets you upload, import from Plex, send to Plex, and clean up orphaned or duplicate asset folders. Files are saved with the names and layout Kometa expects. Kometa must be set up to create asset folders first (assets_for_all and create_asset_folders). On first start, KAM asks you to create a login: open the container's log (KAM icon, Logs) for the one-time setup code.

paths.name: Assets Root
paths.description: Root folder that contains Movies/TV/Collections subfolders

paths.name: Config Folder
paths.description: Where KAM keeps its settings, folder assignments and exclusions

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Container 8000 -> Host port for the web UI

variables.name: Plex Verify SSL
variables.description: Set to false only if Plex uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate.

variables.name: Auth Mode
variables.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the Settings page, or set builtin, reverse_proxy, or none. none turns the login off completely; only use it if KAM can't be reached from anywhere you don't trust.

variables.name: Auth Username
variables.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the Settings page.

variables.name: Auth Password
variables.description: Optional. Setting a password skips the first-run login setup. Leave blank to create the login in KAM instead.

variables.name: Secure Auth Cookie
variables.description: auto detects HTTPS; true forces an HTTPS-only cookie; false allows plain HTTP.

variables.name: CORS Origins
variables.description: Optional comma-separated origins allowed to call the API from another website. Leave blank to keep it off.
